set.body: From the cold review of 23db27133 (F6, F7). No killing test for: multi-token name matching, longest-first and same-segment rules (the body link uses a two-token name); the end margin; duplicate Name - All withholding; character-and-role-label refusal and count validation; missing rows; empty timing; check_asr input sha, clock origin and start; start_pts, streamhash parse, stream count and edition validation; the universe fallback; the exact 0.5 and 30 s boundaries. The order court reverses only words. On the Scala side no test admits asr-transcript, so deleting the role kills nothing.
